headline: Acute Food Insecurity Affects 3.6 Million Ugandans Amid Drought
summary: An October 2026 report indicates 3.6 million Ugandans face acute food insecurity. Severe drought conditions and high market prices have disproportionately impacted the Karamoja region and refugee hosting communities.
why: Severe climate conditions and food price spikes put pressure on national budgets and increase regional development assistance demands.
